data.title: 夏洛特 · 更衣室百叶窗下的校服心跳
data.description: IS学园训练场后方安静的更衣室内，夕阳透过百叶窗在更衣柜前拉出条条光影。夏洛特正穿上专属的法式校服，领口系带尚未打好，衬衫微敞露出白皙细腻的肌肤。微汗打湿了她的鬓角，看见进门的身影，平时温柔体贴的少女瞬间手足无措，红着小脸急忙系紧领带，眼中却溢满了心动的小鹿乱撞。
data.action: buttoning up IS academy uniform shirt in front of open locker, collar slightly open, blushing deeply with wide bashful blue eyes, afternoon sunbeams on golden hair
data.location: school locker room with open lockers and wooden benches in afternoon light
data.lighting: warm amber sunset light filtering through slatted window blinds
data.mood: sweet heart-fluttering embarrassment, precious school-day intimacy
data.promptProse: Fastening her academy uniform collar in front of an open locker, Charlotte turns with a startled, bright blush. Golden light filters through window blinds across her bare collarbone and blonde ponytail in flustered charm.
data.animaCaption: Charlotte buttoning her uniform in the locker room, blushing flustered in afternoon light.
